about:
Cope Plastics Inc operates a branch in Fargo, North Dakota, located four miles from Hector International Airport at 3331 South University Drive. The facility is supported by the company's headquarters in Alton, Illinois, which houses what the firm describes as the largest collection of CNC plastic fabrication equipment in the Midwest. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in the available materials.

The Fargo location provides custom plastic fabrication using CNC saws, routers, and drills, producing custom parts, prototypes, and cut-to-size components from engineering plastics. The branch maintains over 7,000 square feet of warehouse space stocked with sheets, rods, and tubes in materials such as HDPE, UHMW, nylon, polycarbonate, and polyurethane, alongside graphic-grade materials like ACM and acrylic. Weekly stocked items include conduit duct spacers, ground protection mats, outrigger pads, and urethane patches.

The company serves industries including fluid handling, food and beverage, construction, mining operations, material handling, and safety and security. Documented applications include solid-lubricant-filled nylon parts for bulk distribution conveyors, food-processing components that eliminate external lubrication, high-temperature polymer parts for kitchen equipment, bearing-grade and oil-filled nylon boom pads for cranes, nylon sheaves for forklifts, and components for mining equipment.

Cope Plastics emphasizes its USA-made fabrication and a streamlined manufacturing process as differentiators from pure distribution companies, citing a commitment to quality and innovation in both materials and manufacturing. The headquarters' extensive CNC capacity is presented as a core advantage for precision and volume.
